diagnostics.title: An autotools build is missing its auxiliary file: config.sub
diagnostics.suggestion: The configure script needs 'config.sub', which `autoreconf -i` (or `automake --add-missing`) copies in from the automake package. The build runs autoconf without installing those files; running `autoreconf -fi` before `./configure` in that step fixes it.
